entities.title: Make keyboard focus visible and predictable
guidance: Provide a visible focus indicator with sufficient distinction from surrounding states and avoid removing browser focus without a replacement.
Keep tab order aligned with reading order and ensure overlays manage entry, dismissal, and focus return.
reasons: Linked by eligible profile PRO-ADMIN-CONSOLE; lower weight than lexical coverage.

entities.title: Use tables when precise comparison matters
guidance: Provide clear column headers and keep units, labels, and actions associated with their row or column.
Use a chart for patterns or trends and a table when users need exact lookup or comparison.
reasons: Linked by eligible profile PRO-ADMIN-CONSOLE; lower weight than lexical coverage.
Linked by eligible profile PRO-ENTERPRISE-DASHBOARD; lower weight than lexical coverage.

entities.title: Make dense data views adapt intentionally
guidance: Prioritize the columns required for the mobile task, allow horizontal scrolling when comparison requires it, or provide a stacked row presentation.
Keep row identity and action relationships clear in alternate views and announce table headers semantically.
reasons: Linked by eligible profile PRO-ENTERPRISE-DASHBOARD; lower weight than lexical coverage.

entities.title: Operational Data Table
guidance: Compare identifiable records and act on an explicitly scoped result set without confusing missing data, permission or selection.
Collection identity and current scope precede column headings; record identifier anchors each row before secondary metadata.

Keep a semantic table in one named horizontal scroll region with native scrollbar visibility (auto); preserve row identity and place the frequent authorized action beside the identity or in a persistent, non-overlapping action area without horizontal travel. Do not convert comparison tasks to cards automatically.
Inspect CMP-OPERATIONAL-TABLE for states, variants, keyboard, recovery, visual checks and anti-pattern references.
reasons: Original generic contract; no domain workflow or rendered quality is claimed.

entities.title: Design default, hover, focus, active, and disabled states
guidance: Define state treatments for pointer, keyboard, pressed, loading, and unavailable conditions as appropriate.
Keep state changes perceivable without relying on color alone and preserve layout stability during loading.
reasons: Required rule reference of selected component knowledge.

entities.title: Advanced Filter Workspace
guidance: Make a collection query explicit, reversible and understandable while distinguishing edited filters from the results currently displayed.
Scope and text search lead; frequent facets precede advanced criteria; active conditions remain visible beside result count.

Move advanced facets into a named disclosure or one focus-managed sheet. Keep query, result meaning, active conditions and Clear reachable; prefer wrapping chips. Horizontal chip scrolling is conditional: show an edge cue or previous/next controls, reveal focused removals and never silently clip selected scope.
Inspect CMP-FILTER-WORKSPACE for states, variants, keyboard, recovery, visual checks and anti-pattern references.
reasons: Original generic contract; no domain workflow or rendered quality is claimed.

entities.title: Make the next action visually unambiguous
guidance: Use one prominent primary action per task region and style secondary actions with lower visual emphasis.
Keep action labels specific about outcomes, such as “Create report” instead of “Continue” when the outcome is known.

entities.title: Operational Management Workspace
guidance: Coordinate a scoped record collection, filters and authorized actions around repeated operational work, with an optional recoverable detail editor.
Workspace title and entity scope lead, followed by query, result count and collection; optional detail follows the selected record.

Choose comparison-scroll versus single-record summary from the task. Keep identity, critical status/permission and frequent permitted action available at narrow widths; move details to a route or one modal surface. Do not nest independent vertical panes unless their task requires them.
Inspect COM-OPERATIONAL-MANAGEMENT for states, variants, keyboard, recovery, visual checks and anti-pattern references.
reasons: Original generic contract; no domain workflow or rendered quality is claimed.

entities.title: Label every form control persistently
guidance: Associate a visible label with each field and keep examples or formats in supporting text.
Use placeholders only for short examples, never as the only label or essential instruction.

entities.title: Validate at the point of need with actionable messages
guidance: Explain the problem in plain language beside the field, describe the expected correction, and associate the message programmatically.
Avoid clearing valid input or showing an error before the user has a fair chance to complete the field.

entities.title: Preserve user input through recoverable errors
guidance: Keep valid values after a failed submission and identify which fields need attention.
For sensitive values that cannot safely be retained, explain the limitation and narrow the re-entry request to those fields.

entities.title: Recoverable Form
guidance: Collect or edit meaningful input with clear grouping, honest save state and a recovery route that retains valid user work.
Task and entity identity lead; group headings organize decisions; labels stay closer to controls than adjacent groups.

Stack related fields in reading order. For an overlay, give its body one vertical scroll owner constrained by the usable viewport; keep Save/Cancel reachable without clipping and reveal focused inputs/errors above any sticky actions. Use native scrollbar auto by default, not global overflow locking.
Inspect CMP-RECOVERABLE-FORM for states, variants, keyboard, recovery, visual checks and anti-pattern references.
reasons: Original generic contract; no domain workflow or rendered quality is claimed.

entities.title: Communicate progress for actions that take time
guidance: Show a concise pending state, prevent accidental duplicate actions, and restore a usable state if the operation fails.
For indeterminate work, explain what is happening without inventing a percentage or blocking unrelated navigation.
reasons: Linked by eligible profile PRO-ENTERPRISE-DASHBOARD; lower weight than lexical coverage.

entities.title: Reuse the project’s established design tokens
guidance: Inspect the project’s current color, typography, spacing, radius, and elevation tokens before adding styles.
Extend the existing token model with the smallest justified addition instead of introducing a competing palette.
reasons: Linked by eligible profile PRO-ADMIN-CONSOLE; lower weight than lexical coverage.
Linked by eligible profile PRO-B2B-SAAS; lower weight than lexical coverage.
Linked by eligible profile PRO-ENTERPRISE-DASHBOARD; lower weight than lexical coverage.

entities.title: Provide a non-visual route to chart values
guidance: Pair the visualization with a concise textual summary and accessible data labels or an equivalent table when detail matters.
Make series names, values, and units available to assistive technology without flooding the tab order with every mark.

entities.title: Keep dashboard filters visible and interpretable
guidance: Show active filters near the data they affect and provide a clear way to reset or adjust them.
Persist filter state only when it helps the workflow, and make the resulting scope visible after navigation or refresh.
reasons: Linked by eligible profile PRO-ADMIN-CONSOLE; lower weight than lexical coverage.
Linked by eligible profile PRO-ENTERPRISE-DASHBOARD; lower weight than lexical coverage.

entities.title: Keep row actions attached to a recognizable record
guidance: Include a stable row identifier and accessible action names that provide context when repeated.
Group infrequent actions in a labeled menu and keep destructive actions distinct from routine navigation.

entities.title: Responsive data table
guidance: Keep semantic headers and row identity intact.
Use a labeled horizontal scroll region or a task-focused stacked row layout.
Prioritize essential columns and retain access to secondary values.

entities.title: Do not use placeholders as the only field labels
guidance: Add a persistent visible label and move examples or formats to supporting text.
Keep programmatic labels associated with the control even when a compact visual layout is required.

entities.title: Placeholder-only form labels
guidance: Users may forget what a field requests after typing.
Low-contrast placeholder text can be difficult to read.
Keep a visible label associated with the field and use helper text for examples.
Use a compact floating label only if it remains readable and semantically associated.

entities.title: Keep workspace identity and scope clear
guidance: Display the active workspace or account in a stable location and retain that scope in page headings when consequential.
Confirm or clearly label actions that affect an entire organization rather than the current user.
reasons: Linked by eligible profile PRO-ADMIN-CONSOLE; lower weight than lexical coverage.
Linked by eligible profile PRO-B2B-SAAS; lower weight than lexical coverage.
Linked by eligible profile PRO-ENTERPRISE-DASHBOARD; lower weight than lexical coverage.

entities.title: Recoverable form validation
guidance: Associate persistent labels and field-level error text with controls.
Preserve valid input after submission errors.
Announce status updates and move focus only when needed to support recovery.

entities.title: Avoid shrinking desktop tables to fit mobile screens
guidance: Choose a mobile-specific presentation or a clearly bounded horizontal scroll region with row identity preserved.
Keep the most important values visible and provide access to secondary columns.

entities.title: Compressed mobile data table
guidance: Columns become ambiguous or clipped.
Small targets increase interaction errors.
Use a deliberate responsive row layout or a scoped horizontal scroll region.
Keep row identity clear and provide the most important data first.

entities.title: Make mobile navigation operable and stateful
guidance: Give the menu trigger an accessible name and expanded state, and make dismissal and focus return predictable.
Avoid hiding the only route to a critical action or relying on hover to reveal destinations.

entities.title: Keep primary tasks reachable on small screens
guidance: Identify the highest-value task for each screen and keep its entry point visible in the narrow layout.
Move secondary controls into a discoverable menu, but preserve labels, keyboard access, and clear open/close states.
